name: DesignEvo
description_en:
DesignEvo is a logo maker from PearlMountain that combines templates, icons, shapes and editable text. A user customizes one logo project and chooses a free credited low-resolution download or a paid package. Basic and Plus are one-time purchases for that project, not a lifetime pass for every logo in the account.

Plus adds vector/font downloads and a qualified copyright-ownership claim. The official FAQ also says templates/elements are shared and individual icon copyright cannot be guaranteed. A package purchase therefore does not establish an exclusive mark or complete trademark clearance.
description_zh:
DesignEvo是PearlMountain的logo制作工具，结合模板、图标、形状及可编辑文字。用户修改一个logo项目后，可选注明来源的免费低分辨率下载或付费包。Basic/Plus是该项目的一次性购买，不是账户全部logo的终身通行证。

Plus增加矢量/字体下载及有条件的版权所有权声明，但官方FAQ也称模板/元素共享、单独图标版权不能保证，因此购买套餐不建立独占标识或完整商标清理。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose a template, enter a name/slogan and adjust icons, shapes and text on the canvas.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可选模板、输入名称/口号，在画布调整图标、形状和文字。

core_features.explanation_en: Paid packages cover one current logo, with high-resolution/transparent output; Plus adds SVG/PDF andfont files.
core_features.explanation_zh: 付费覆盖一个当前logo，提供高分辨率/透明输出，Plus增加SVG/PDF及字体文件。
FAQ对Plus所有权附共享资源及第三方图标权利条件，不保证独占。

pricing.summary_en: Free credited 300 pxoutput; currentdisplayed Basic USD 24.99/Plus 49.99 one-timeperlogoproject(discountedreferenceprices 49.99/99.99).Plus adds PDF/SVG/fontsandqualifiedrights; tax/offerdurationunverified.
pricing.summary_zh: 免费注明来源的300px输出；当前显示Basic USD24.99/Plus49.99，按单logo项目一次性（参考划线49.99/99.99）。Plus增加PDF/SVG/字体及有条件权利，税/优惠期限未核。

sections.title_en: Customize the actual objects before choosing the output
sections.title_zh: 选择输出前先修改实际对象
sections.en:
The getting-started tutorial has the user choose a template, enter the logo name/slogan and open the canvas. The ICON/SHAPE panels add or replace graphic elements; the text toolbar adjusts font, size, color, outline, shadow, alignment and other styling. The downloaded result should be checked at its intended size and on a transparent/solid background as required. No logo was created or exported here.

The tutorial says sign-in is needed for download and describes a free low-resolution route requiring credit through a social/blog/website mention. The pricing table calls this Give Credit. Do not interpret “free logo” as a free exclusive brand, unlimited-size output or permission to remove every credit condition. Desktop/mobile links have separate offerings whose entitlement was not established here.
sections.zh:
入门教程要求选模板、输入logo名/口号并进入画布，ICON/SHAPE面板增换图形，文字工具调字体、尺寸、颜色、描边、阴影、对齐等。下载结果需按目标尺寸及透明/实底要求检查，本次未创建或导出logo。

教程称下载需登录，并描述通过社交/博客/网站提及来注明来源的免费低分辨率方式，价格表称Give Credit。“免费logo”不能当作免费独占品牌、无限尺寸或免除注明条件。桌面/移动链接还有其他方案，本次未建立其权益。

sections.title_en: Select raster or vector deliverables deliberately
sections.title_zh: 明确选择位图或矢量交付
sections.en:
The live table shows Free up to 300 pxand Basic/Plus up to 5,000 px. Basic and Plus include transparent PNG, ongoing editing/re-download and print-ready marketing labels. The visually inspected table places PDF/SVG vector files, font downloads and copyright ownership only in Plus; Basic does not receive those merely because its bitmap is high resolution.

An SVG can be edited in compatible design software, but that does not guarantee every text/font/icon remains an independently licensed, portable object. Inspect a representative file and its actual font rights before a printer/client handoff. The header’s logo-animation link goes to Flex Clip, a separate product; it is not evidence of animation export included in this logo package.
sections.zh:
实时表格显示Free最多300px，Basic/Plus最多5,000px；两付费档含透明PNG、持续编辑/重下及print-ready宣传。视觉核对表格将PDF/SVG矢量、字体下载及版权所有权仅列Plus，Basic的位图高分辨率不意味着获得这些权益。

SVG可在兼容设计软件编辑，但不保证每个文字/字体/图标都是独立许可、可移交对象。印厂/客户交接前应检查代表文件及实际字体权利。页头logo动画链接指向独立FlexClip产品，不能证明本logo包含动画导出。

sections.title_en: Pay for one logo project, not every future design
sections.title_zh: 付费对象是一个logo项目，不是以后全部设计
sections.en:
The observed current offer displays Basic USD 24.99 and Plus USD 49.99, with reference amounts 49.99 and 99.99 crossed out. Both are labeled one time. The pricing text and FAQ explicitly limit the purchase to the current logo project, while the FAQ allows unlimited edits to that purchased logo. Confirm tax, offer duration and exactly what counts as a new project before checkout.

The FAQ advertises 7 days from purchase to request a refund. A lifetime-access/support label is not an offline source backup or a guarantee that every future service remains available. Keep purchased files and necessary asset/license records. No payment, refund, account retention or new-project entitlement was tested.
sections.zh:
实读当前优惠为Basic USD24.99、Plus USD49.99，参考49.99/99.99划线，均标一次性。价格文本及FAQ明确购买只覆盖当前logo项目，FAQ允许对该已购logo不限次修改；结账前需确认税、优惠期限及何为新项目。

FAQ宣传购买日起7天内可申请退款。终身访问/支持标签不是离线源稿备份，也不保证未来全部服务持续可用；应保留已购文件及必要资产/许可记录。本次未付款、退款或测试账户保留/新项目权益。

sections.title_en: Read the ownership claim with the shared-icon limitations
sections.title_zh: 结合共享图标限制阅读所有权声明
sections.en:
The FAQ claims ownership for a customized logo purchased with Plus, but immediately qualifies it:templates/elements are available to other users, insufficiently modified designs may not be exclusive, and the service cannot guarantee individual icon copyright. It identifies Noun Pro jectas an icon source and recommends checking those terms and local copyright/trademark requirements. The service says it does not provide copyright or trademark registration services.

Record that as a vendor-qualified offer, not a legal finding that a particular mark is registrable or cleared. A distinct color/name/font treatment does not establish that no other business has relevant rights. If exclusive brand ownership is essential, use original commissioned graphics or obtain a proper rights review; that review was not performed here.
sections.zh:
FAQ对修改后购买Plus的logo主张所有权，但紧接限定：模板/元素也供其他用户使用、修改不足可能不独占，服务不能保证单独图标版权；其指Noun Project为图标来源，建议检查该条款和当地版权/商标要求，并称不提供版权或商标注册服务。

应将此记录为厂商有条件方案，不能当作特定标识可注册或已清理的法律判断。改颜色、名称及字体不证明不存在其他相关权利。独占品牌必需时，应使用原创委托图形或取得正式权利复核，本次未做该复核。

sections.title_en: Use a sample logo to validate file and brand requirements
sections.title_zh: 用样本logo验证文件及品牌需求
sections.en:
DesignEvo is plausible for a small project needing a quickly customized logo and defined downloadable files. A buyer requiring scalable vector output should evaluate Plus rather than assume all paid tiers include it. Complex bespoke illustration, brand strategy, exclusive-icon ownership and trademark work are separate tasks.

Pilot the name/slogan at small and large sizes, check transparent PNG edges and vector/font behavior, and decide who owns the editable account project after client delivery. Current sharing/transfer, version recovery, complete export and app-specific rights remain unverified. Native FAQ/tutorial requests timed out, but their normal browser pages were readable; expanded answers were captured individually. No login, design, download, animation, registration or purchase was executed.
sections.zh:
需要快速定制logo及明确下载文件的小项目可评估DesignEvo；需要可缩放矢量时应评估Plus，不能假定所有付费档都有。复杂原创插画、品牌策略、图标独占及商标工作是其他任务。

试点可检查大小尺寸名称/口号、透明PNG边缘及矢量/字体行为，并决定客户交付后可编辑账户项目归谁；当前分享/转移、版本恢复、完整导出及应用专属权利仍未核实。普通FAQ/教程请求超时，但正常浏览器可读，展开回答已逐项保存。本次未登录、设计、下载、动画、注册或购买。
